(function(){
    function getBlock(){
        var inp = document.querySelector('[name="custom5"]');
        if (!inp) return null;
        var fg = inp.closest('.form-group') || inp.closest('div');
        if (!fg) return null;
        return { input: inp, group: fg, label: fg.previousElementSibling };
    }
    function toggle(){
        var b = getBlock();
        if (!b) return;
        var sel = '';
        document.querySelectorAll('[name="custom4"]').forEach(function(r){ if (r.checked) sel = r.value || ''; });
        var show = sel.toLowerCase().indexOf('outr') !== -1;
        b.group.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
        if (b.label) b.label.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
        if (!show) b.input.value = '';
    }
    document.addEventListener('change', function(e){
        if (e.target && e.target.name === 'custom4') toggle();
    });
    if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', toggle);
    else toggle();
})();
